# Schema-21 delta migration fixture

Frozen before appearance fields were implemented, from commit
`88ee5e83861b8bd639a2237deca0fb9ae838e2a6`, Godot 4.7.2 official ed1daf0bf.
The JSON sidecar records original byte hashes and the exact acknowledged final
canonical payload hash. Neither binary fixture is regenerated by tests.

The ordinary legacy-map test colony was saved at tick 1800. A normal one-tile
turnip field command was followed by ten ticks and one durable delta. A normal
Mira Growing preference command was followed by ten further ticks and a second
delta. `load_latest()` on the old code verified the final hash before copying
the snapshot and its journal. No gameplay state was granted or rewritten.

Recovery on schema 22 folds both deltas against the exact schema-21 snapshot,
then migrates the acknowledged final payload once. Stripping only the new
appearance dictionaries and restoring the original schema header must yield
the frozen hash. Both originals and migration backups must retain their hashes.
This catches old whole-citizen replacements losing fields when mixed with an
already upgraded snapshot.
